en: {player}! Mom said you'd come by. Is it true? All eight of Johto's Badges?
I knew it. Ever since you chose your first Pokémon in Professor Elm's lab, I knew you'd go all the way.
The road to the League runs west from here, by Route 27 and Tohjo Falls. Go on. I'll be cheering for you!
What are you still doing here? The League is waiting for you!
